title: The Machine with the Stretching Arm
synopsis: A yellow telehandler uses its telescopic boom and pallet forks to place bundled roof panels on the adult work platform. Molly and Rex observe from the farm porch while Gus tries to guess how the machine reaches up without driving under the roof.
continuity_state: Before: Mr. Lee has prepared replacement timber for the small wagon-door shelter and Jack has tested a braced tabletop frame. Timber and roof panels wait in the marked work yard. Main barn, farm vehicles and dry hay are intact. After: A yellow telehandler has delivered a strapped pallet of roof panels onto the adult work platform by extending its boom while stationary. Mr. Lee and crew have the replacement shelter framing braced and installed; roof materials are positioned for fastening. No child came near the work zone or load. The telehandler will be taken away after unloading.
